intro: Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–4 p.m. Our spring beta opens {{opening_long}}. Older children mentor younger ones, and each child learns at their own pace. Families can request a place on the Fall 2027 waitlist.

hatch.text: Where it all starts: free and guided play, sign language, music, nature and gentle routines, with big kids as mentors.
hatch.soonNote: The Hatch is coming soon. Join the list and we’ll share the details first.

studio.text: Advanced academics every morning; real businesses, podcasts and adventures out in the community every afternoon.

morning.text: Children learn in small groups through Socratic discussions.

afternoon.text: Children build practical life skills through community projects. They start businesses and learn alongside experts.
